description: Search New York Times movie reviews. Optionally filter by query or critics picks. Returns title, summary, byline, publication date, and URL. Example: movie_reviews({ query: "dune", critics_pick: true })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NYT API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

critics_pick.description: If true, only return reviews flagged as NYT Critics’ Picks (optional).

query.description: Search query — movie title or keyword (optional).

name: movie_reviews
title: Movie Reviews
